ACME_SRE: hitting a weird thing where some requests from our EU region are routed to us-west intermittently, spikes in p99 latency ~600ms. Not all requests, ~1-3%

maya (support): hey — can you paste a failing request header and a request id? we can look up routing logs

ACME_SRE: sure. sample curl we used:
```
curl -v https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-xxx" \
  -H "X-Client-Region:" \
  -H "X-Client-Region-Param: eu-west-1" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
request-id: rq_0a1b2c3d

ACME_SRE: notice the header X-Client-Region is present but empty — we set it from an SDK that sometimes populates an empty string when region resolved to null.

maya (support): thanks. two quick questions — is X-Client-Region sent as a header AND as a query param in some flows? and does this only affect requests that include an empty header?

ACME_SRE: we only set the query param in one offline tool; main SDK sends headers. This started after rolling out SDK v2.4.1 last week.

alex (eng-oncall): pinging router-bot to check routing decision for rq_0a1b2c3d

router-bot: routing-log: rq_0a1b2c3d received at edge eu-1 -> header X-Client-Region present (value: empty-string) -> header precedence rule applied -> mapped to region tag 'west' due to parse bug -> routed to us-west-2. latency penalty applied.

alex (eng-oncall): confirmed. looks like an old parser treats empty strings as a token that matches fallback map which maps to 'west' (legacy). reproing locally now.

maya (support): is this causing billing cross-region? customer says some requests got billed at us-west rates/metrics.

sam (billing): if routed to us-west, metering will record us-west host tags. we can backfill if it's a bug. need list of request-ids and time window.

ACME_SRE: we've captured a small sample: rq_0a1b2c3d, rq_0f9e8d7c, rq_0b2c3d4e (window 2026-02-12 14:22 to 14:38 UTC).

alex (eng-oncall): reproduction notes: sending header `-H "X-Client-Region:"` (no value) triggers parser code path:
```
// pseudo
if (header.exists) {
  region = parse(header.value) // returns ""
  if (region in fallback_map) route = fallback_map[region]
}
```
fallback_map[""] -> 'west' (bad)

Fix options: treat empty-string as absent, or normalize before map lookup.

alex (eng-oncall): quick hotfix deployed to edge eu-1: treat empty header as absent. will monitor for 30m.

router-bot: hotfix deployed to eu-1 at 2026-02-12T15:02:10Z, change-id: ch_7744f.

maya (support): ACME, can you confirm if you still see misrouted requests after 15:02 UTC?

ACME_SRE: rerunning tests now. initial 200 requests -> 0 routed to us-west. looks fixed. we still have SDK users who might send empty headers; we'll patch SDK to stop sending empty X-Client-Region.

alex (eng-oncall): follow-up: will roll fix to other edges and add a unit test to ensure empty -> treated absent. also adding metric to count "empty-region-header" occurrences to catch this earlier.

sam (billing): for billing: ACME, we'll reconcile the handful of affected requests. I'll open a billing ticket and follow up privately.

ACME_SRE: appreciate it. a couple of asks: 1) can you add guidance in docs for SDK authors (prefer omit header vs empty), 2) any ETA on SDK patch?

maya (support): noted. we'll update docs and create an internal doc for SDK teams. alex — can we get a quick patch for the SDK repo?

alex (eng-oncall): will file PR today: treat undefined region as null and drop header in SDK v2.4.2. ETA EOD.

ACME_SRE: thanks all. leaving this thread open for the billing ticket link and SDK PR. :thumbsup:

maya (support): thanks — closing once billing ticket created and PR linked.
